description: This file defines the ClusterMembershipSnapshot class, which models a snapshot of the cluster's membership state in the Orleans runtime. It includes properties for members and version, methods for creating updates, and status retrieval for silos.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the cluster's membership, including members and version, with methods to generate updates and retrieve silo statuses.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor initializing the snapshot with members and version.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Provides a default empty snapshot with minimal version.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specified silo based on current membership data.

methods.name: AsUpdate
methods.description: Creates a ClusterMembershipUpdate representing this snapshot.

methods.name: CreateUpdate
methods.description: Generates an update comparing this snapshot with a previous one, identifying changes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the snapshot.
